reports.title: Onto Innovation Reports 2026 Third Quarter Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026, the Company expects the following:

desk.headline: Revenue up 88% to a record $410m, beat; Q4 outlook above estimates
results: Record revenue of $410m was up 88% on a year ago and 19% on Q2, above the top of the company's own range.
Adjusted EPS rose to $2.44 from $0.92; GAAP EPS of $0.95 was held back by a $40.8m paper loss on the Rigaku stake.
Margins widened: adjusted gross margin 57.6% and adjusted operating margin 32.6%, up from 21.1% a year ago.
Advanced nodes and advanced packaging both set revenue records, led by the Atlas G6, Dragonfly G5 and Firefly tools.
Operations brought in about $79m of cash; Onto closed its purchase of a 27% stake in Rigaku in August.

guidance.summary: Onto guided Q4 revenue of $430–450m and adjusted EPS of $2.59–2.79, both above analyst estimates, and expects full-year revenue growth above 45%.

points: Management said customers have not slowed orders despite questions over data-centre spending, with visibility into 2027 and partly 2028.
Advanced packaging was just over half of revenue; growth there is split roughly evenly between 2.5D logic and HBM memory.
Revenue is expected to keep rising quarter by quarter through at least the first half of 2027.
A rough 2027 margin framework of about 50 basis points of gross-margin gain per quarter was offered, with a full plan due later.
Higher supply-chain costs, including memory chips, are a pressure; parts are being redesigned to use less.
call.source: Call coverage: MarketBeat via Yahoo Finance, 9 Nov 2026; consensus figures from Investing.com, 9 Nov 2026

watch: Whether Q4 lands in the $430–450m range and margins move toward 58%.
Quarterly paper gains or losses on the Rigaku stake, which swing GAAP earnings.
Any sign of slower chip-equipment orders as AI data-centre spending is questioned.
